_why: #89/#91 (his 11-06 asks: 'a .GIF for coldcrow just like it is here', 'unified across the platform and rendering the same'). One sprite per monster, the same file in D2IO_ART (every artUrl/artOr surface) and in Quick wins' _QW_SU_ART. Source order: diablo.fandom.com's '<Name> (Diablo II).gif' (his example), else rankedboost.com's assets/boss/<Name>.gif (the same classic sprites: Coldcrow is byte-for-byte the same 57x73, 13 frames on both). Every one was looked at, enlarged where small, before it was used. | v3877 #102 (his 11-07 'render just the monster not the area behind it'): the act bosses' sprites joined - fandom first (Andariel, Baal, Mephisto), rankedboost otherwise (Diablo, Duriel, Nihlathak, Pindleskin); each looked at on a contact sheet before it entered the page. | v3899 #91 (REG-3961, GrokBot): 'no sprite on either source' was a CASE miss on rankedboost - 'Lord de Seis.gif', 'Treehead Woodfist.gif' and 'Blood Witch the Wild.gif' are there, and 'The Countess.gif' (13 frames, 38x87) too; all four were opened and added. Hell Bovine stays sprite-less (no file on either source). Two monsters still share bytes: see sharedSprite. | v3899 #91b (REG-3963, GrokBot, his 11-11 ruling 'give each priest its own picture'): the six Travincal Council priests each wear THEIR OWN in-game capture from The Arreat Summit's Act III super-unique page (each named there; the full capture carries its in-game name plate), six different byte sets, none Bartuc's and none the shared councilmember_graphic.png. rankedboost's six council GIFs are Bartuc's bytes; see rejected.
